16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Restrained emotional performance.

Natural physical movement.

Fast but readable combat.

Realistic body weight and impact.

Natural fire,
heavy breathing,
wood creaking,
footsteps,
weapon impacts,
and environmental sound.

No dialogue.
No subtitles.
No background music.

No magical activation.
No glowing runes.
No power-up.

Use only THREE major cinematic shots.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Continue directly after Scene 35.

Riven is still inside the damaged burning building.

The Mysterious Dark Figure
is standing outside the broken opening.

Riven forces herself back onto her feet
and continues fighting.

She manages to defend herself
and attempts to fight back,
but the figure still overwhelms her.

Riven is knocked down again.

Exhausted among the debris,
she looks at the weapon in her hand.

The moment triggers two brief memories:

her injured father,

then her fallen ally.

Return immediately to the present.

Riven remains down,
physically exhausted
and emotionally shaken.

CUT.


=== SHOT 1 — GET UP ===

OPEN IMMEDIATELY
on a reverse close-up of Riven.

The previous scene ended from behind Riven,
looking through the broken wall
toward the Mysterious Dark Figure.

Now cut to the opposite angle.

Camera faces Riven
from the direction of the broken opening.


Riven is still low
among the broken wood and debris.

Warm orange firelight from outside
creates a rim light around her hair.

She is breathing heavily.

Her face is exhausted.

Her eyes remain fixed
on the figure in front of her.


Riven tightens her grip
on her weapon.

She forces herself
back onto her feet.


CUT to a side angle.


The Mysterious Dark Figure
steps through the broken opening.

Riven raises her weapon defensively.


A brief still moment.


Then—

the figure suddenly changes
from complete stillness
to unnatural speed.


It rushes directly toward Riven.


Riven reacts—

BLOCK.


HEAVY IMPACT.


Riven is driven backward
through the debris,

but remains standing.


=== SHOT 2 — STILL OUTMATCHED ===

The Mysterious Dark Figure
moves rapidly through the smoke.


Riven turns
and defends against another attack.


She manages to create
a brief opening.


Riven immediately attempts
one strong counterattack.


But the figure slips away
before her attack can connect.


Riven turns to follow it—


too late.


The figure suddenly rushes back.


A powerful impact
knocks Riven off balance.


Riven falls hard
among the broken wood and debris.


Keep the movement physical and grounded.


Riven tries to recover,

but her body is exhausted.


The Mysterious Dark Figure
remains nearby within the smoke.


=== SHOT 3 — WHAT SHE LOST ===

Stay close to Riven.


She remains low
among the debris.

Her breathing is heavy.


Riven looks down
at the weapon still in her hand.


The sounds of the burning building
slowly become distant and muffled.


Hold briefly on Riven's eyes.


Then—


MEMORY FLASH.


Use MEMORY REFERENCE 1.


A very brief fragmented image
of Riven beside her injured father.

Preserve the emotional moment
shown in the provided reference.

Do not expand it into a new scene.

Do not introduce additional actions.

It should feel like a painful image
suddenly returning to Riven's mind.


FLASH OUT.


MEMORY FLASH.


Use MEMORY REFERENCE 2.


A very brief fragmented image
of Riven beside her fallen ally.

Preserve the emotional moment
shown in the provided reference.

Do not expand it into a complete scene.

Keep it brief,
fragmented,
and emotionally immediate.


FLASH OUT.


CUT BACK TO PRESENT.


Close on Riven's face.


The sound of fire
slowly returns.


Riven remains among the debris.


Her hand is still holding the weapon.


She looks emotionally shaken
by what she has remembered.


Beyond her,

the Mysterious Dark Figure
stands partially obscured by smoke.


Riven looks toward it.


She has not recovered yet.


No magical energy.

No glowing runes.

No sudden heroic recovery.


Hold the tension.


CUT.


=== END STATE ===

Riven remains inside
the damaged burning building.

She is conscious,
hurt,
and physically exhausted.

She is still holding her weapon.

The weapon remains visually consistent
with the provided reference.

The Mysterious Dark Figure
remains nearby.

Riven has just remembered
her injured father
and her fallen ally.

These memories belong only to the past.

Father and Ally are not present
in the current environment.

Riven has not powered up yet.

CUT.
